# Support — @harshsinghmp/muse-skills

## Where to ask

- Bugs and reproducible defects: https://github.com/harshsinghmp/muse-skills/issues
- Usage questions: GitHub Discussions, if enabled for this repository; otherwise ask the project owner for the preferred support channel.
- Security vulnerabilities: follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md); do not disclose them publicly.

Before asking, search existing issues and documentation. Include the expected result, actual result, reproduction steps, and relevant environment details. Remove secrets and personal data from logs.
